scope: Chronology of the native-DSA A100 round on 2026-10-02/03 (UTC), with every failure and the fix applied.

steps.what: Port vLLM PR #38476 (TRITON_MLA_SPARSE) onto SKT axk2-v0.23.0
steps.result: git apply --3way: four files clean, sparse_attn_indexer.py conflicted with the v0.23 XPU branch.
steps.fix: Merged as XPU -> DeepGEMM -> Triton; restricted the backend to non-SM90/SM100; recorded as aml/src/dsa_port.json; offline application byte-identical to the merged tree.

steps.result: 11 of 12 failed: 'Soft-deleted workspace exists' (names reused from the deleted round).
Job queued in 12 regions; italynorth and uksouth both allocated 2 x ND96amsr at 23:39Z.
steps.fix: first_capacity_wins.sh now wins on node allocation, cancelled 11 jobs and deleted the uksouth cluster holding 2 nodes.

steps.result: Overlay + DSA port verified on both nodes; 94/94 PR kernel tests passed; 2-layer native TP8, dense TP8 and native TP8 x PP2 passed and were compared with the official reference. The full-checkpoint download stalled on both nodes at about 68% (241/355 files after 3.5 minutes, then no progress for 50 minutes), so the full-model phases were skipped.
steps.fix: Hub throughput probe from the same network: 326-476 MB/s per file, HTTP 200, no rate limiting. stage_weights.py now downloads in a child process under a watchdog (restart after 180 s without progress, resume, 16 workers).

steps.result: Download 568 s and 926 s per node; full model native (healthy in 302 s) and dense (171 s) served and measured; job exit 0.
Some vLLM start-up summaries never reached the job record; the per-node progress line could not be parsed (tqdm carriage returns).
steps.fix: report.py ASCII-escapes and retries; launcher logs download progress with carriage returns split; facts recovered by collect-run-outputs.yml from the private artifacts.

cost_estimate_usd.basis: Retail Spot USD 12.89 per ND96amsr node-hour in italynorth/uksouth on 2026-10-02 x observed allocation windows; the Azure invoice is authoritative.

cleanup: Resource group rg-axk2-aml-208d24c1 (12 workspaces, storage, key vaults, private endpoints, clusters) deleted at 02:09Z.
